summary: In 2025, Saudi Arabia's GDP was USD 1,276,942,933,333.33 and GDP per capita was USD 34,536.6555, with inflation of 2.0842%. As of 2026-09-12, the SAR / USD exchange rate was 0.266276 USD per SAR with a -3.049% change, while the 10-year bond yield is unavailable (null). Over 2016–2025, GDP ranged from USD 689,279,466,666.667 in 2016 to USD 1,276,942,933,333.33 in 2025, GDP per capita peaked at USD 38,510.2276 in 2022, and inflation ranged from -1.193% in 2019 to 3.3723% in 2020.
